changelog:
1.1.4

  • Fix: form styles not loading when rendered via Elementor widget. The CSS (and JS) is now declared as a widget dependency so Elementor loads it whenever the widget is on the page. Fixes 'Auto/Inherit/Minimal modes all look the same' caused by missing stylesheet.

1.1.3

  • Auto-updater now reads directly from GitHub Releases. No per-release manifest file updates required going forward.
  • Add native Elementor style controls: Container, Labels, Inputs, Submit Button, and field spacing.
  • Fix: 'Inherit' theme mode now fully hands off styling to the host theme.

1.1.2

  • Fix: country field visibility when preset_country is set on campaign form.
